facts.fact: Yes: UGC publishes a 'List of Fake Universities' on ugc.gov.in (under HEIs Violating Regulations), currently dated 'As of February 2026', also in Hindi
facts.quote: List of Fake Universities (As of February 2026) List of Fake Universities in Hindi

facts.fact: To check a university, confirm it against UGC's lists of fake and of valid universities on the UGC website
facts.quote: List of the Fake Universities and valid Universities is available on the UGC website www.ugc.ac.in. Kindly confirm from UGC list.

facts.fact: A degree awarded by a fake university is not valid, whether or not its name is on the UGC website
facts.quote: Degree awarded by a Fake University is not valid whether or not the name of the University is on the UGC website.

behaviour: Points to UGC's list of fake universities with its date (as of February 2026) and the lists of valid universities on the UGC website, cited.
fail_if: It says UGC does not publish such a list, gives the list without its date or citation, or names universities as fake that are not on UGC's current list.
summary: Added from ugc.gov.in: List of Fake Universities (as of February 2026); UGC FAQ says to confirm against the fake/valid university lists, and fake-university degrees are not valid.
